name: Buzzsprout
description: Buzzsprout is a podcast hosting and publishing platform for creating, distributing, and measuring podcast episodes. Creators use it to host audio, schedule releases, maintain episode metadata, and distribute shows to listening platforms.
agentUseSummary: Enter the API token and exact podcast ID from the customer's own Buzzsprout account, then let agents inspect that podcast and create or update episodes under Safe or Dangerous policy; imported audio consumes that account's upload allowance.

credentialRequirements.name: BUZZSPROUT_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Buzzsprout API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the API token from the customer's own Buzzsprout account.

credentialRequirements.name: BUZZSPROUT_PODCAST_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Buzzsprout podcast ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind the connection to one numeric podcast ID returned by Buzzsprout.

capabilities.label: Read connected podcast
capabilities.description: Read bounded redacted metadata for the exact connected podcast.

capabilities.label: Read episodes
capabilities.description: List bounded redacted episodes or inspect one exact episode.

capabilities.label: Create and update episodes
capabilities.description: Create episodes and change their metadata, media URLs, privacy, or publication schedule.

allowed.label: Read connected podcast
allowed.description: Read redacted metadata for the exact podcast bound to this connection.

approvalRequired.label: List episodes
approvalRequired.description: List at most fifty redacted episode summaries from the exact podcast.

approvalRequired.label: Read episode
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact redacted episode, including unpublished episode metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Create episode
approvalRequired.description: Create an episode, optionally import public HTTPS media, and consume the customer's upload allowance.

approvalRequired.label: Update episode
approvalRequired.description: Change episode metadata, privacy, publication schedule, or hosted media references.

blocked.label: Delete episodes
blocked.description: The official API documentation does not publish an episode deletion operation.

blocked.label: Upload local files
blocked.description: Multipart local-file upload is not mounted; V1 accepts only validated public HTTPS media URLs.

blocked.label: Administer Buzzsprout
blocked.description: Plans, billing, team members, podcast settings, directories, dynamic content, ads, subscriptions, and account administration are outside the documented API.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Buzzsprout APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, query-token authentication, browser automation, and undocumented endpoints are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Connected-podcast metadata runs directly; episode reads and every publishing change require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected documented Buzzsprout API action runs without Relay per-action approval while exact-podcast binding, credential secrecy, fixed origin, URL and response bounds, audits, upload allowance, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Buzzsprout tools and injects the encrypted token and exact podcast binding server-side.
Railway mounts selected Buzzsprout tools and injects the encrypted token and exact podcast binding server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Buzzsprout API token, exact podcast ID, eligible plan, or signed-in provider session is available for production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Accept Buzzsprout's experimental API terms, obtain a token and podcast ID for the customer's own account, connect them in Relay Console, then verify exact-podcast binding, bounded reads, Safe denial, approved or Dangerous draft creation and update, redaction, token rotation, and disconnect. Import media only deliberately because it consumes that account's upload allowance.

evidence.supports: Buzzsprout publishes an experimental REST and JSON API for third-party integrations under API-specific terms.

Official episode documentation publishes bounded list, read, create, and update operations and documents metadata, publication, privacy, public media URL, and multipart fields; no delete operation is published.
Official podcast documentation provides an account podcast list used to fail closed unless the token authorizes the exact configured podcast ID.
Buzzsprout documents that uploads consume the customer's monthly allowance and may trigger plan-specific overage behavior.
